role: Stagiaire, Conception mécanique et électrique - Laboratoire de développement de produit (Hiver 2027)
jd:
L’innovation est dans notre ADN… est-elle dans le vôtre?

Bombardier est un leader mondial de l’industrie de l’aviation en créant des avions novateurs qui changent la donne sur leur marché. Ses produits et services fournissent des expériences de calibre international établissant de nouvelles normes en matière de confort-passager, d’efficacité écoénergétique, de fiabilité et de sécurité. Nous sommes une organisation mondiale axée sur la collaboration et l'esprit d'équipe.

Votre billet d’embarquement comprendra… 

Plusieurs conférences :



- Rencontrez un.e exécutif.ve
- Envolée au féminin


Apprendre davantage sur Bombardier :



- Conférence sur Les produits Bombardier 
- Visites des sites Bombardier 
- L’Académie d'apprentissage Bombardier 


De nombreuses opportunités de réseautage et d'échanges sociaux :



- Du bénévolat 
- Réseauter pour réussir
- 5 à 7, repas entre stagiaires, et bien plus encore!


Quelles sont vos contributions envers l’équipe?



- Vous joindrez l’équipe d’intégration des essais au sol et en vol au sein du Centre de de développement de produit aéronautique de Bombardier.
- Concevoir est développer des équipements d’essai et des prototypes pour les laboratoires de conception avancée des systèmes avioniques et des postes de pilotage
- Produire les dessins et devis pour les harnais électriques, les circuits imprimés, les assemblages mécaniques et les modifications aux composants d’avion en vue des essais au sol en laboratoire.
- Coordonner les activités de conception et de fabrication au sein du laboratoire en collaboration avec les intégrateurs d’essai et les chargés de projet
- Planifier, suivre et contrôler les échéanciers et les coûts de conception, en identifiant les risques critiques et en définissant des stratégies de mitigation adaptées aux projets sous votre responsabilité.
- Interpréter les exigences techniques pour développer des solutions robustes, conformes aux critères de conception, tout en optimisant les coûts et les délais.
- Participer au développement des futurs programmes d'avions de Bombardier en contribuant à la validation expérimentale de technologies innovantes et à l'amélioration de la performance des programmes d’essai.


Comment vous épanouir dans ce rôle? 



- Vous êtes inscrit à un programme universitaire de génie électrique, mécanique ou aérospatial. 
- Vous avez préalablement suivi un programme technique collégial en génie mécanique ou en électro-technique ou êtes diplômé de l’École National d’Aérotechnique. 
- Vous êtes rigoureux dans la planification, l’exécution et la documentation des tâches. 
- Vous êtes hautement motivé, curieux, autonome et polyvalent. 
- Vous êtes à l’aise à utiliser de nombreux outils manuels pour installer des pièces mécaniques, modifier du filage électrique, des connecteurs, des circuit imprimés, etc. 
- Vous êtes à l’aise à utiliser de nombreux instruments et équipement de laboratoire tel que des senseurs, des oscilloscopes, des multimètres, etc. 
- Vous avez une bonne maîtrise du français et de l’anglais 
- Vous maîtrisez CATIA V5 et/ou Autocad et avez de la facilité à apprendre à utiliser de nouveaux logiciels. 
- Vous avez des bases en programmation C++, C# et Python. 


 Information d’embarquement:



- Site: BAN
- Durée: 8 mois
- Travail flexible-Hybride


Il est important de noter que nos opportunités de stage sont ouvertes aux étudiants et non aux nouveaux gradués.

Tous nos stagiaires peuvent être appelés à voyager occasionnellement à l'extérieur du Canada pour des raisons de formation ou de travail.
fit_why: Mechanical/electrical hardware lab role; no web or software focus

Please Note: Interviews for this role will be conducted exclusively on December 9 and 10, 2026. We will not be able to accommodate alternative interview dates. Candidates must be available on one of these dates to be considered for this opportunity.


At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
These internship opportunities span multiple teams across eBay, including:

- Customer Analytics & Growth, where you may analyze customer behavior and identify opportunities to improve engagement, retention, and growth
- Discovery & Personalization, where you may use data science and machine learning to uncover insights and improve product experiences
- eBay CortexAI, where you may explore Generative AI and large language models to build intelligent analytics tools and solutions
- eBay Services, where you may analyze marketplace data to identify opportunities for product and business improvements
- Focused Categories Data Science & Analytics, where you may uncover customer trends and growth opportunities across marketplace categories
- Shipping Data Science & Analytics, where you may analyze large datasets, develop predictive models, and leverage AI-powered analytics to uncover insights that inform product and business decisions.


Candidates may be considered for opportunities across these teams based on their skills, interests, and business needs.
Please note that while the summer internship is located in San Jose, CA, full-time return offers following graduation may be located in Austin, TX.
About the Role
We're looking for curious, analytical, and innovative Data Science & Analytics Interns to join us for Summer 2027.
As an intern, you'll have the opportunity to work on meaningful, real-world challenges that directly impact eBay's business and the experiences of millions of buyers and sellers. You'll take ownership of projects, turn complex data into actionable insights, and contribute ideas that help shape business and product decisions.
You'll collaborate with experienced Data Scientists, Analysts, Engineers, Product Managers, and business leaders, gaining hands-on experience, mentorship, and exposure to how data informs decisions at scale.
This is an opportunity to grow your technical and problem-solving skills, explore new approaches and technologies, and make a measurable impact while learning from teams across eBay.


What You Will Accomplish

- Uncover meaningful trends in large-scale customer, transactional, and product data, translating analysis into actionable recommendations that improve marketplace experiences and business decisions.
- Apply statistical methods, predictive modeling, machine learning, and customer segmentation to understand behavior, investigate performance drivers, and identify opportunities for growth.
- Help improve customer engagement, retention, discovery, and personalization by evaluating customer journeys and recommending data-informed product and marketplace improvements.
- Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and business teams to define success metrics, support experiments and A/B tests, and assess the impact of product changes and business initiatives.
- Explore Generative AI and large language models to make analytics workflows more effective, including natural-language-to-SQL and AI-assisted analysis, while assessing output accuracy and reliability.
- Build clear dashboards, visualizations, and data stories; share findings with technical and nontechnical partners, and grow your skills through hands-on work and collaboration with experienced teammates.


What You Will Bring
Basic Qualifications

- Currently enrolled full time in a 4-year accredited U.S. Master's program in Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and Summer 2028.
- No more than 3 years of relevant professional experience, excluding internships, co-ops, fellowships, and similar student experiences.
- Proficiency in SQL and Python to analyze, manipulate, and draw insights from data.
- A strong foundation in statistics, analytical methods, and data science, with experience using datasets to identify patterns, test hypotheses, and solve problems through coursework, research, projects, or work.
- Familiarity with at least one NoSQL or big data tool, such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark, Pig, or H2O.
- Familiarity with Generative AI, LLMs, or AI-assisted analytics tools, combined with analytical problem-solving and the ability to communicate findings and collaborate with diverse partners.


Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with machine learning, predictive modeling, or customer segmentation.
- Exposure to AI concepts such as prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, or natural-language-to-SQL.
- Experience using Tableau or similar tools to visualize data and communicate insights.
- Familiarity with distributed data processing technologies such as Spark, Hadoop, or Hive.
- Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, or statistical hypothesis testing.
- Interest in product analytics, customer behavior, e-commerce, personalization, or marketplace dynamics; exposure to R or Java is a plus.


What Makes You Successful

- You're naturally curious and enjoy understanding not just what the data shows, but why it matters.
- You combine strong analytical thinking with a willingness to experiment, learn new technologies, and challenge assumptions.
- You're comfortable working through ambiguity, collaborating with others, and connecting technical insights to meaningful business outcomes.
- Most importantly, you're excited to use data, analytics, and emerging AI technologies to solve real-world problems and make an impact at scale.

Vancouver · Hourly · Entry-level

#### **About The Position**

**Software Development Co-op– Summer 2026**

  
  

**A Career at Clarius**

Today, as many as 25 million medical professionals globally don’t have access to medical imaging, which is proven to improve patient care and reduce healthcare costs. That’s why we’re on a mission to make medical imaging accessible everywhere by delivering high-performance, affordable, and easy-to-use solutions powered by artificial intelligence and connected to the cloud.

  
  

By making Clarius your next career move, you’re joining a team of 140+ people who are talented, innovative, and highly collaborative. You’re also joining a community that includes thousands of physicians worldwide who use Clarius to deliver better patient care – over two million high-definition exams have been performed using Clarius! And you’re joining a thrice-certified Great Place to Work!

  
  
  

**Your Role**

Located in Vancouver, BC, Clarius designs high-performance handheld ultrasound systems that make medical imaging more accessible and affordable through AI-powered solutions.

We are seeking innovative, dedicated people to join our Cloud team for a co-op project and gain hands-on experience developing scalable, customer-focused software solutions.

This cloud-focused project includes front-end and back-end development, REST API enhancements, and modernization of cloud-based UI components. You will work within a complex full-stack codebase and gain hands-on experience applying test-driven development practices.

  

**Core Responsibilities**

* Improve accessibility and mobile layouts
* Adhere to test‑driven development (TDD) practices
* Assist senior developers on larger and more difficult projects
* Build UIs with Vue, Tailwind and PrimeVue
  

  

**Education, Experience & Skills**

* Currently pursuing a degree in Software Development or a similar degree.
* Full-Stack Web Development with Python or JavaScript
* Familiarity with REST APIs
* Experience with frameworks such as Django, Vue, or similar
* Attention to detail
* Independent and self-motivated
* Ability to understand complex software architectures
* Exposure to C++ and QT is considered an asset
* A design portfolio (Figma or similar) is considered a bonus
* Interest in healthcare or medical imaging
  

  
  

**Location and Compensation:**

This is a hybrid position, so candidates must be within commuting distance of our headquarters in Vancouver, BC.

  
  

This is a temporary full time role at 40 hours per week for a minimum of 8 months.

  
  

The hourly rate for this role is $22 to $25 CAD.

  
  
  

**More Reasons to Consider:**

**Workspace:** Our modern office features sit/stand desks, various health & wellness facilities, a stocked kitchen, outdoor amenities, on-site daycare, enclosed parking, a free on-site gym and close proximity to a SkyTrain station.

  
  

**Learning, Growth, and Career Development:** Work alongside experienced professionals to receive mentorship and guidance, enhancing your knowledge and skills in software and cloud-based solutions.

  
  

**Impactful Work**: Contribute to meaningful projects that improve access to healthcare, making a difference in people’s lives while developing your professional abilities.

  
  

*Clarius Mobile Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage applications from any qualified candidate regardless of ethnicity, religion, age, national origin, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. Please let us know if you require any accommodations during the interview process.*

  

#### **Requirements**

* **Required**
* Currently enrolled in a co-op programme in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field
* Full-stack web development with Python and JavaScript
* Experience with Django and Vue
* Familiarity with REST APIs
* Strong attention to detail and able to work independently in a complex codebase

**Assets**

* Previous web development co-op or internship
* Unit testing experience
* A design portfolio (Figma or similar)
* Exposure to C++ or Qt
* Interest in healthcare or medical imaging
fit_why: Full-stack web role; Vue/Django gap, strong JS/Python and REST match
